primary_protocol.fact: SetInterfaceVersion uses service command5 with oneu32 version on the assumed-domain SSL service; this is an IPC interface revision rather than a TLS version.

implemented_contract.endpoint: ssl:s only; no unobserved ssl fallback service registration.
implemented_contract.registration: runtime_ipc_register_retained with real open/retain/close state callbacks; no shared runtime/loader/builder changes.
implemented_contract.object: Each independent SM open creates a genuine manager with references1 and undeclared interface_version0. Generic session clones/domain copies retain that same manager; independent opens have independent declaration state.
implemented_contract.command5: Require type6, exact4 raw bytes, no PID/COPY/MOVE/X/A/B/W/C descriptors. Only measured version3 is accepted; it is persisted under the manager mutex. Repeating3 is idempotent.
implemented_contract.result: Empty Result0 acknowledges the stored interface-version declaration only; no raw output, object, connection or certificate result.
implemented_contract.lifetime: Mutex-protected bounded references; final owner close frees the manager. Domain conversion transfers its existing ownership to the root object; domain transport clones retain the domain, while CopyFromDomain owns a separate retained session.
implemented_contract.guard: Constructor only registers the endpoint. Service open and every command require the existing diagnostic compile opt-in and private host scratch guard.
implemented_contract.unsupported: Every command except5 explicitly stops, including context factories0/100, context counts, certificate queries/imports, session cache, debug and connection/handshake-related methods. Unmeasured interface versions and type4/TIPC requests stop.
implemented_contract.no_TLS_readiness: Interface-version declaration does not initialize an Apple TLS context, open a socket, connect, accept a certificate, validate trust, perform a handshake, or complete TLS I/O. No SDK initializer is replaced.
implemented_contract.no_legacy_bypass: No lm3_hle ssl_initialize/context_ok/import fake stub is enabled or edited.
implemented_contract.no_pre_main_or_request_IO: No account identity, process lookup, profile creation, filesystem write, keychain, certificate store, network call or TLS API is invoked by this module.

future_native_TLS_boundary.state: Design only; no implementation or claimed compatibility.
future_native_TLS_boundary.BSD: The existing diagnostic BSD bridge does not expose actual native sockets. A Horizon socket number cannot be reinterpreted as a macOS descriptor.
future_native_TLS_boundary.API_selection: Installed Apple SDK labels SecureTransport deprecated/unsupported and recommends Network.framework. A future backend must select an actual supported transport/protocol API and bind real typed socket ownership before acknowledging TLS methods.
future_native_TLS_boundary.trust: No certificate acceptance or verification-disabled policy is introduced. Trust/hostname/protocol and connection errors require separate measured protocols and real host backing.
future_native_TLS_boundary.stateful_children: Future context/connection objects require genuine retained child ownership. The current runtime_ipc_new_session helper has no retain parameter; no borrowed dynamic child or lifetime leak is added here.
